takeaway: The computer-use wave now has a commercial number: E2B, which gives AI agents cloud computers, reports passing a $100M run rate. On GitHub, NVIDIA's new agent framework auto-ontology was today's fastest riser (+2,127 stars).

findings.heading: E2B passes a $100M run rate
findings.text: The company, which gives AI agents their own cloud computers, says it passed $100M in annualized run rate; its release headline says $120M. Read from search results.

findings.heading: NVIDIA's auto-ontology rises fastest
findings.text: NVIDIA/auto-ontology, a framework for graph-based reasoning over data for agent workflows, went from 5,729 to 7,856 stars in a day.

findings.heading: Figma's MCP server: about 1M weekly users
findings.text: Figma said on its Q3 call that its MCP server has approximately 1 million weekly active users. Read from search results.

findings.heading: Forecasts steady
findings.text: The Oct 30 ranking scored a rank correlation of 0.64 and got 47% of its top 15 right across 98 apps; random picks would get about 15%.

caveats: Company figures today come from search-result summaries; one acquisition-inflated growth figure was dropped.
The first forecast built mostly on API measurements is scored on Nov 8.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
